judgment.prompt: Explain why the arithmetic alone shows this arrangement must fail, and name three checks a person could run before putting money into any offer. Say which of your checks would have been quickest here.
acceptableAnswerCriteria: Explains that with no real earnings the payouts come out of the pool itself, so the $200,000.00 is exhausted in 33.3 months and only new money postpones that.

Connects the guarantee to the 42.58% figure: the size of the promised return and the certainty of it cannot both be true at once.
